newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen says EWK not yet sold.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen says EWK not yet sold.

text.p: Thyssen Stahl AG said on Friday its unit Edelstahl Witten Krefeld GmbH (EWK) was still for sale, denying reports the sale had been completed to Austria's Boehler Uddeholm.

Thyssen, in the process of merging its steel operations with Fried. Krupp AG Hoesch-Krupp, said it was holding talks with potential investors in stainless-steel maker EWK as part of its effort to focus on flat steel products, but that no decisions had been reached.
Media reports say Boehler Uddeholm is interested in buying only part of EWK, while Thyssen is only interested in selling it as a whole.
